brand.notes: Running header, title block and every body mention go through the \ac macro, which sets the period in AC pink. The bibliography entry carries a plain period, since a .bib field cannot colour it.

diagrams.notes: Inspected at full resolution after a restructure. The first draft ran a single chain with 'needs a licence' on the edge leaving advertise, which read as though advertising needed one; the two available acts now sit as equal-width peers on a shared baseline and converge into distribute, so the gate label reads as an additional requirement rather than a property of either parent. Arrows terminate on borders with no tangents, the today/next rail orients the two bands, and every label is legible at print size.
